description: Fork of exp603 (1.4295 SoTA). SINGLE change: out_proj tph per-layer schedule [2048, 2048, 1024, 1024, 512, 512] (pyramidal: heavy-early, taper-late). Replaces exp603's uniform tph=1024. Atom count per layer scales with tph (131K, 131K, 65K, 65K, 33K, 33K); atom width and K=64 unchanged. Per-row gradient coverage UNCHANGED at 128 tok/row across all layers. Total out_proj params 150.99M -> 176.16M (+25.17M, +17% of out_proj). Total trunk BW 75.5 -> 88.08 Mbits (+12.58). Reference: project_outproj_per_layer_schedule (exp303 at 602M scale): heavy-early (L0+L1 boost) was strict -0.011 win; tapering L4-L5 to 512 was sharply harmful (+0.015). Net at exp603's scale unclear; this combines both into one config. Predicted total ~314.6M params, ~181.7 Mbits trunk, ~584 Mbits total.
